title: Instructor in Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences
bio: Dr. Rousson is a part-time clinical instructor in the advanced graduate implant dentistry program at the Harvard School of Dental Medicine. He obtained his DDS in 1986 at the University of Lyon, France and his DMD in 1990 at Boston University School of Graduate Dentistry. He participates actively in surgical training related to dental implant placement. Rousson is a Fellow of the American Academy of Implant Dentistry, for which he served for 5 years as Chair of the Education Oversight Committee. He is a Diplomate of the American Board of Oral Implantology/ Implant Dentistry, a Fellow of the Academy of General Dentistry, and a fellow of the International Team of Implantology.
